purpose: Privacy-minimized normalized provider observation correlated to a DANTE email intent without treating provider feedback as canonical account truth.

columns.name: email_provider_event_ref
columns.meaning: Stable UUIDv7 identity of the normalized provider observation.

columns.name: provider_code
columns.meaning: Provider that emitted the observation; currently SES only.

columns.name: provider_event_id
columns.meaning: Provider event identity or deterministic digest fallback used for idempotent ingestion.

columns.name: provider_message_id
columns.meaning: SES message identity used to correlate the observation to one accepted attempt.

columns.name: event_type_code
columns.meaning: Normalized provider observation type such as delivered, bounce or complaint.

columns.name: received_at
columns.meaning: Instant DANTE admitted the normalized observation.

columns.name: payload_digest
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the bounded admitted provider payload for evidence integrity without retaining raw content.

foreign_keys.name: fk_email_provider_event_intent
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Provider observations are evidence about one DANTE-owned delivery intent.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_provider_event_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Require stable UUIDv7 identity without using it as chronology authority.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_provider_event_provider_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep feedback semantics bounded to the implemented provider contract.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_provider_event_provider_identity
check_constraints.expression_contract: provider_event_id = btrim(provider_event_id) AND provider_event_id <> '' AND provider_message_id = btrim(provider_message_id) AND provider_message_id <> ''

check_constraints.name: ck_email_provider_event_event_type_code
check_constraints.reason: Bound provider observations to reviewed normalized event families.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_provider_event_payload_digest_length
check_constraints.reason: Require exact SHA-256 evidence digest length.

indexes.name: ix_email_provider_event_intent_ref
indexes.reason: Intent evidence-history lookup and FK support.

state_history.current_binding: Append-only normalized provider evidence; it does not overwrite DANTE intent truth or Account/EmailIdentity semantics.
state_history.chronology: Provider observed_at and DANTE received_at are preserved separately.
state_history.immutability_policy: Provider event rows are insert-only for dante_runtime after idempotent correlation.

lifecycle.retention: Retained as privacy-minimized provider-delivery evidence under the Auth/security retention policy.
lifecycle.redaction: Raw provider payload, headers, recipient content and recovery/OTP secrets are not stored; only a digest and bounded safe detail survive.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime UPDATE or DELETE; duplicate observations are ignored by provider identity.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL idempotent feedback correlation and privacy-minimized persistence proof.
